statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels only where the family's stock rises across the step: select W.level → W.stock ds t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a selection holding only where the family rises past the inflow

statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels only where the family's stock rises across the step by more than the containing family's inflow: select W.level → W.stock ds t + L.inflow es t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a selection holding only where the family rises past the slack

statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels only where the family's stock rises across the step by more than the slack of the dependences beyond: select W.level → W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: the selection holds

statement.en: the selection holds of the flow's levels: select W.level

name.en: each condition beyond depended on at a need met

statement.en: each condition of the family beyond is depended on at the step by the formation named on it, at a need it meets: W.requires t (dep c) c ∧ W.need t (dep c) c ≤ W.level t c for every c in rest (Web.MetOn dep rest t)

name.en: a rise past the slack and the inflow

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step by more than the slack of the dependences beyond with the whole's inflow: W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t + L.inflow (ds ++ rest) t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a rise past the slack

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step by more than the slack of the dependences beyond: W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t < W.stock ds (t + 1)

name.en: a rise with the loss past the slack

statement.en: the family's rise with what the whole loses across the step exceeds the slack of the dependences beyond: W.stock ds t + W.slack dep rest t < W.stock ds (t + 1) + L.lost (ds ++ rest) t

name.en: each condition beyond still required after the step

statement.en: after the step, the formation named on each condition beyond still requires it: W.requires (t + 1) (dep c) c for every c in rest

name.en: each need beyond no weaker after the step

statement.en: after the step, the need of the formation named on each condition beyond is at least its need before: W.need t (dep c) c ≤ W.need (t + 1) (dep c) c for every c in rest

name.en: the beyond apart from the family

statement.en: no condition beyond is in the family: c ∈ rest → ¬ c ∈ ds

name.en: a formation taking part at the step

statement.en: the formation named takes part in the flow across the step from t: f ∈ L.present t

name.en: a formation raising the family

statement.en: across the step from t the formation f gives the family ds more than it takes from it (Flow.RaisesOn ds t f)

name.en: every member of the generation takes part

statement.en: every member of the generation listed at a step takes part in the flow across that step: p ∈ G.family t → p ∈ L.present t; at each step the law names, one step or every step of a stretch

name.en: a generation's amount read as reaching beyond

statement.en: each member's amount in the generations is whether it reaches beyond across the step: G.amount t p = L.reach rest t p; at each step the law names, one step or every step

name.en: more offspring only to raisers

statement.en: within a generation, a member with more offspring than another raises the family across the step: G.offspringNumber t p < G.offspringNumber t q → L.RaisesOn ds t q; at each step the law names, one step or every step of a stretch

name.en: reaching beyond carried to offspring

statement.en: at every step of the stretch, each offspring of a member taking from the conditions beyond takes from them at the next step: 0 < total rest (L.take t p) → k ∈ G.kids t p → 0 < total rest (L.take (t + 1) k)

name.en: exact transmission

statement.en: each offspring carries its parent's amount exactly (SelectionTerm.Exact); at every step of the stretch the law names

name.en: the share moved over the stretch

statement.en: the share reaching beyond at the end of the stretch differs from the share at its start, compared by cross-multiplying: G.size 0 * G.sum T ≠ G.size T * G.sum 0

name.en: a dependence at the step

statement.en: the formation g requires the condition c at the step named: W.requires t g c

name.en: a need met at the step

statement.en: the need of g on c at the step is at most c's level there: W.need t g c ≤ W.level t c

name.en: a dependence broken across the step

statement.en: across the step from t the dependence of g on c breaks: g requires c at t, its need is met at t, and c's level after the step is below that need (Web.Broken t g c)

name.en: each drawer's take within the joint slack

statement.en: every formation taking part takes from c no more than the level with all that is given stands above the need: L.take t f c + W.need t g c ≤ W.level t c + L.given t c for every f present

name.en: a level as high

statement.en: the restrained flow's level of c at the step is at least the other's: W.level t c ≤ W'.level t c

name.en: taking less by e

statement.en: the restrained flow takes from c at least e less than the other: L'.taken t c + e ≤ L.taken t c

name.en: giving no less

statement.en: the restrained flow gives c no less than the other: L.given t c ≤ L'.given t c

name.en: e covers the excess

statement.en: e is at least the excess of the need n with what the other flow takes over the level with what it gives: n + L.taken t c ≤ W.level t c + L.given t c + e

name.en: a renewal gated at need m

statement.en: whatever formation gives to the condition c across a step requires c there at a need of at least m: e ∈ L.present t → 0 < L.give t e c → W.requires t e c ∧ m ≤ W.need t e c, at every step (m = 1 where the law says need one)

name.en: the rest's takers present

statement.en: at each of the n steps from T, every member of the rest taking from c takes part in the flow there: j < n → f ∈ rest → 0 < L.take (T + j) f c → f ∈ L.present (T + j)

name.en: the rest outruns the renewal

statement.en: at each of the n steps from T, the rest takes jointly more from c than is given to it: j < n → L.given (T + j) c < total rest (fun f => L.take (T + j) f c)

name.en: a start below n + m

statement.en: the level of c at T is below the number of outrun steps with the need: W.level T c < n + m (n + 1 where the need is one)

name.en: a member outside the rest

statement.en: the member g is not in the rest: ¬ g ∈ rest

name.en: a member taking its chooser's choice

statement.en: at every step it takes part, the member g takes from c what its chooser chooses at its reading there: g ∈ L.present t → L.take t g c = ch.chosen (reading t)

name.en: a preferred level at least the need

statement.en: the chooser's preferred level is at least the need m: m ≤ ch.preferred

name.en: a choice at no risk

statement.en: the chooser's choice at the level read at T + n + k has no risk: ch.risk l (ch.chosen l) = 0 for l = W.level (T + n + k) c

name.en: one of the two steps the takers take part

statement.en: the step t is one of the first two, at which the takers take part: t < 2

name.en: what is given bounded by B

statement.en: what is given to the condition c across every step is at most B: L.given t c ≤ B for every t

name.en: more rising steps than the bound

statement.en: the take rises at more steps than the bound on what is given: B < n

name.en: the seeker takes part while active

statement.en: at every step the seeker f is active, it takes part in the flow: W.active t f → f ∈ L.present t

name.en: activity not resumed once stopped

statement.en: from T on, the seeker is active at a step only where it was active at the step before: W.active (T + i + 1) f → W.active (T + i) f

name.en: the seeker active while the level is at least m

statement.en: from T on, the seeker is active at every step at which the level of c is at least m: m ≤ W.level (T + j) c → W.active (T + j) f

name.en: a part of the family

statement.en: the part named is in the family: p ∈ ps

name.en: a part's position rises

statement.en: across the change of amounts from a to b, what lowers p's position is below what raises it: fallCount ps a b p < riseCount ps a b p

name.en: a least part

statement.en: no part of the family has an amount below the part l's: a l ≤ a q for every q in ps (RelativePosition.Least ps a l)

name.en: balance at the condition across the steps

statement.en: the flow balances on the condition c at each of the steps the law names from T: L.BalancesOn W [c] (T + j)

name.en: joint excess across the steps

statement.en: at each of the n steps from T, more is taken from c than is given to it: L.given (T + k) c < L.taken (T + k) c

name.en: active only while supported

statement.en: at the step named, the formation g is active only while supported: W.active t g → W.Supported t g

name.en: a start below n with g's need

statement.en: the level of c at T is below the n steps of joint excess with the need of g on c at T + n: W.level T c < n + W.need (T + n) g c

name.en: every part requires the condition from the race's end

statement.en: every part of the family requires c at every step from T + n on: g ∈ p :: ps → W.requires (T + n + k) g c

name.en: every part needs at least m from the race's end

statement.en: every part of the family needs at least m of c at every step from T + n on: g ∈ p :: ps → m ≤ W.need (T + n + k) g c

name.en: dissipated on a family across a step

statement.en: across the step from t, every formation taking part gives the family cs no more than it takes from it, and at least one unit less where it takes (Flow.DissipatesOn cs t); at each step the law names, one step or every step of a stretch; on that family, not the World premise of dissipation on every closed family

name.en: taking from the family recurs

statement.en: formations take from the family at arbitrarily late steps: for every N there is a step t ≥ N with 0 < L.takers cs t

name.en: the list holds every condition

statement.en: the list all holds every condition: c ∈ all for every c

name.en: more without end

statement.en: the flow is more without end on the family: for every K, from some step on at least K formations take from it (Flow.More cs)

name.en: formations arising taking from the family at arbitrarily late steps

statement.en: for every N there is a step t ≥ N at which some formation arises and takes from the family at its first active step: L.ArisesTaking W cs t f

name.en: a formation giving at the step

statement.en: the formation f gives something to the condition c across the step from t: 0 < L.give t f c

name.en: balance on the family across a stretch

statement.en: the flow balances on the family ds at each step of the stretch from S to S + N: L.BalancesOn W ds t for S ≤ t < S + N; on that family, not the World premise

name.en: something conveyed from the family at each step

statement.en: at each step of the stretch, some formation taking part takes from a member c of the family and gives to some d: ∃ c d, c ∈ ds ∧ L.Conveys t c d

name.en: the active parts listed at each step

statement.en: at each step the list names exactly the active parts: p ∈ alive t ↔ parts p ∧ W.active t p (Web.Listed parts alive); not a list without repetition

name.en: a formation's activity ends

statement.en: the formation's activity ends: from some step on it is never active (Web.Ends f); where the law names parts, for each part

name.en: no part arises from N on

statement.en: no part arises across any step from N on: N ≤ t → parts p → ¬ W.Arises t p

name.en: a whole of parts

statement.en: w is the whole of the formations satisfying parts: it is active exactly while some part is (Web.Whole parts w)

name.en: renewal gated on the family

statement.en: whatever formation gives to a member of the family ds across a step depends there on some member at a need of at least m: f ∈ L.present t → d ∈ ds → 0 < L.give t f d → ∃ e ∈ ds, W.requires t f e ∧ m ≤ W.need t f e

name.en: parts arise depending on the family

statement.en: a part arises only where, after the step, it depends on some member of the family at a need of at least m: parts p → W.Arises t p → ∃ e ∈ ds, W.requires (t + 1) p e ∧ m ≤ W.need (t + 1) p e

name.en: parts arise depending on the condition

statement.en: a part arises only where, after the step, it depends on the condition c at a need of at least m: parts p → W.Arises t p → W.requires (t + 1) p c ∧ m ≤ W.need (t + 1) p c

name.en: the family's uptake exceeds its replenishment

statement.en: at each of the n steps from T, the family's uptake exceeds its replenishment: L.replenishment ds (T + k) < L.uptake ds (T + k)

name.en: a family stock below n + m

statement.en: the family's stock at T is below the number of excess steps with the need: W.stock ds T < n + m

name.en: a part of the witness

statement.en: p is one of the witness's parts: Generations.parts p

name.en: a region inside another

statement.en: every formation of the region region' is in the region region: region' f → region f

name.en: loss beyond a region

statement.en: beyond the region, some formation the levels l' admit at t the levels l do not admit: ∃ f, ¬ region f ∧ W.Admits l' t f ∧ ¬ W.Admits l t f (Web.LosesBeyond region l l' t)

name.en: an order rising with a family

statement.en: the order ranks every outcome exceeding another on the family above it (Optimum.Rising ds better)

name.en: a season's outcome

statement.en: the outcome is that of a season of ten steps of the named model run from its start (Optimum.Season.Eligible o); for every weighted season, where the law weighs a list of them

name.en: the bay kept at three or more

statement.en: the season leaves the bay at three or more: 3 ≤ o bay

name.en: two histories apart through a formation's couplings

statement.en: the two level histories are not alike through g's couplings up to t: ¬ W.AlikeThroughUpTo obs g l l' t

name.en: balance on what couples into the closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: each flow balances at every step on each condition coupled into a member of f's coupling closure drawn through both flows: WithinClosure (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) f g → W.CoupledInto obs g c → L.BalancesOn W [c] t (and L'.BalancesOn W' [c] t for the second flow); balance assumed nowhere else

name.en: a common start on what couples into the closure

statement.en: the two flows start alike on every condition coupled into a member of f's coupling closure drawn through both flows: W.level 0 c = W'.level 0 c

name.en: the closure responds through its couplings

statement.en: every member h of f's coupling closure drawn through both flows, wherever the flows are alike through h's couplings up to t, exchanges alike in the two flows across the step from t with every condition coupled into a member of the closure

name.en: within the coupling closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: g lies within f's closure under being affected through what couples in, in either of the two flows (or the two courses the laws name): WithinClosure (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) f g

name.en: the rest follows the law

statement.en: outside the part, the flow exchanges as the law gives under its level history: part h = false → L.take t h c = law.take t h l c ∧ L.give t h c = law.give t h l c (Flow.Follows law part l); for each of the two flows the law names

name.en: a common start

statement.en: the two flows start at the same level on every condition: W.level 0 c = W'.level 0 c for every c

name.en: the part acts alike within the closure

statement.en: each member of the part within f's coupling closure drawn through both flows, coupled alike up to t, exchanges alike in the two flows across the step from t with every condition a member of the closure couples into (Flow.ActsAlikeWithin L' W W' obs part f); where the law names a group, for each member f of the group

name.en: the selection fails of the second flow

statement.en: the selection does not hold of the second flow's levels: ¬ select W'.level

name.en: the part's act reads through the part's couplings

statement.en: the act law reads, for each member of the part, only what couples into that member: act.Through W obs (fun h => !part h)

name.en: the two acts agree within the closure

statement.en: the two acts exchange alike, for each member of the part, with every condition coupled into a member of f's coupling closure drawn through the two courses: act.take t h l c = act'.take t h l c ∧ act.give t h l c = act'.give t h l c

name.en: the two acts agree within the group's closure

statement.en: the two acts exchange alike, for each member of the part, with every condition coupled into a member of the group's coupling closure drawn through the two courses

name.en: balance on what couples into the pool's closure

statement.en: the flow balances at every step on each condition coupled into a member of the group's pooled coupling closure: L.WithinPoolCoupling W obs group g → W.CoupledInto obs g c → L.BalancesOn W [c] t

name.en: the part beyond the pool's closure

statement.en: no member of the part lies within the group's pooled coupling closure: part h = true → ¬ L.WithinPoolCoupling W obs group h

name.en: the pool within the group's closure

statement.en: every member of the pool lies within the group's pooled coupling closure: pool g → L.WithinPoolCoupling W obs group g

name.en: the pool within the group's closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: every member of the pool lies within the group's coupling closure drawn through both flows (or courses): pool g → WithinClosureOf (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) group g

name.en: the act changes a formation's admission

statement.en: the two flows differ at step s in admitting x: ¬ (W.Admits (W.level s) s x ↔ W.Admits (W'.level s) s x)

name.en: the group listed

statement.en: the list holds exactly the members of the group: group g ↔ g ∈ members

name.en: the selecting group outside the acting part

statement.en: every member of the selecting group (or pool) is outside the acting part: group h → part h = false

name.en: a selection through a group's acts

statement.en: histories under which every member of the group exchanges alike, by the law, across every step up to t are selected alike (ExchangeLaw.SelectsThroughActs group t select)

name.en: a formation outside the part

statement.en: the formation h is outside the acting part: part h = false

name.en: within the group's closure drawn through both flows

statement.en: h lies within the group's coupling closure drawn through both flows: WithinClosureOf (L.CoupledFromEither W L' obs) group h

name.en: balance at the condition at every step

statement.en: the flow balances on the condition c at every step: L.BalancesOn W [c] t for every t (for each of the two flows the law names)

name.en: alikeness at the condition changes

statement.en: whether the two courses are alike at c at s + N differs from whether they are at s: ¬ (W.level (s + N) c = W'.level (s + N) c ↔ W.level s c = W'.level s c)

name.en: the courses alike again at the condition

statement.en: the two courses are alike at c at s + N: W.level (s + N) c = W'.level (s + N) c

name.en: the courses apart at the condition

statement.en: the two courses differ at c at s: W.level s c ≠ W'.level s c

name.en: the part acts alike with the condition after s

statement.en: from s on, every member of the part takes from and gives to c alike in the two courses: s ≤ t → part h = true → L.take t h c = L'.take t h c ∧ L.give t h c = L'.give t h c

name.en: balance on what couples into formations outside the responsive reach

statement.en: each flow balances at every step on each condition coupled into a formation outside the part's responsive reach: ¬ L.WithinResponse L' W obs part g → W.CoupledInto obs g c → L.BalancesOn W [c] t (and for the second flow)

name.en: a common start outside the responsive reach

statement.en: the two flows start alike on every condition coupled into a formation outside the part's responsive reach

name.en: the rest responds through its couplings

statement.en: each formation outside the part exchanges alike in the two flows across the step from t wherever the flows are alike through its couplings up to t (Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling L' W W' obs part)

name.en: nothing within the responsive reach exchanges with the condition from s

statement.en: from s on, no formation within the part's responsive reach takes from or gives to c in either flow

name.en: a selection read off a group's couplings

statement.en: histories alike through every member's couplings at every step are selected alike (Web.ReadOffCouplings obs group select)

name.en: the act reads significance within a region

statement.en: significances agreeing on every formation of the region give the part the same act on every condition coupled into a member of the region, under every level history (ActReadsWithin act part W obs region)

name.en: the two significances agree within the closure

statement.en: the two significances agree at every standpoint and step on every formation within the group's coupling closure drawn through the two courses: sig p t g ↔ sig' p t g

name.en: own closure within the coupling closure

statement.en: the center's closure under the relation lies within its coupling closure: WithinClosure rel (center p) g → L.WithinCoupling W obs (center p) g

name.en: a formation beyond the coupling closure

statement.en: h lies beyond the center's coupling closure: ¬ L.WithinCoupling W obs (center p) h

name.en: a relation within coupling in

statement.en: whatever the relation relates to a formation exchanges with a condition coupled into it: rel g h → L.CoupledFrom W obs g h

name.en: a formation whose acts return

statement.en: whatever the formation can affect can affect it (Flow.ReachReturns W f)

name.en: the standpoint centred on the clearer

statement.en: the standpoint p's center is the clearer: center p = clearer

name.en: every formation listed

statement.en: the list holds every formation: g ∈ members for every g

name.en: a course removes a line

statement.en: the line is alive in the course at the start and, from some step on, is not (RemovesLine slotsOf l i)

name.en: a course whose lines settle

statement.en: from some step T on, every line either persists (stands at arbitrarily late steps) or is not alive: ∃ T, ∀ i, StandsLate (slotsOf i) l ∨ ∀ t, T ≤ t → ¬ AliveIn slotsOf l t i

name.en: every listed line persists

statement.en: selection by persistence read off a fixed pool holds: every listed line persists (AllPersist slotsOf l)

name.en: a reader's own standing coupled into it

statement.en: the reader r couples into its own standing by level: obs r r

name.en: the first step apart

statement.en: T is the first step at which some member of the group is admitted under one course and not the other: some member differs in admission at T, and every member is admitted alike at every earlier step (Web.FirstApart group l l' T)

name.en: a step before the first step apart

statement.en: the step s read is before the first step apart: s < T

name.en: a family telling the courses apart at a step

statement.en: the family's selection for step T selects the two courses differently, and its selection for every earlier step alike (Web.TellsApartAt sel l l' T)

name.en: balance before D

statement.en: each course balances at every step before D: W.level (t + 1) c + L.taken t c = W.level t c + L.given t c for t < D and every c (for each of the two courses)

name.en: the same formations present before D

statement.en: the two courses have the same formations present at every step before the bound: t < D → L.present t = L'.present t

name.en: a common start

statement.en: the two courses start at the same level on every condition: W.level 0 c = W'.level 0 c

name.en: the responders respond through their coupling before D

statement.en: at every step before D, every formation other than a source there exchanges alike in the two courses wherever they are alike through its couplings by obs up to that step

name.en: no member reached in time by D

statement.en: the closure in time of no source occurrence, read through either course, meets a member of the group by D: group g → ¬ Flow.ReachedInTime L L' W obs source g D

name.en: the loss lowers what the member requires

statement.en: l is at most l' at t on every condition g requires there: W.requires t g c → l t c ≤ l' t c

name.en: the levels admit a formation

statement.en: the levels admit the formation at the step: they meet every requirement it then has (Web.Admits l t f)

name.en: a source that goes on

statement.en: a source occurrence's formation is a source at the next step: source t h → source (t + 1) h

name.en: the point of no return

statement.en: N is the first step at which the course is not recoverable (NoReturnAt feasible keeps l N)

name.en: a family reading in time

statement.en: the family tells the losing course l from l' apart at a step at which l is still recoverable (Web.ReadsInTime sel feasible keeps l l')

name.en: every member admitted alike up to D

statement.en: every member of the group is admitted alike under the two courses at every step up to D: group g → t ≤ D → (W.Admits (l t) t g ↔ W.Admits (l' t) t g)

name.en: past return at D

statement.en: the losing course is not recoverable at D: ¬ Recoverable feasible keeps l D

name.en: the other course admits every member up to D

statement.en: at every step up to D the levels l' admit every member of the group: group g → t ≤ D → W.Admits (l' t) t g

name.en: gaps within the margins up to D

statement.en: at every step up to D, on every condition a member requires, the gap between l and l' is within the member's margin under l': gap (l t c) (l' t c) ≤ l' t c − W.need t g c

name.en: what is kept includes every member's admission

statement.en: every course meeting what is kept admits every member of the group at every step: keeps m → group g → W.Admits (m t) t g

name.en: the other course admits every member throughout

statement.en: l' admits every member of the group at every step: group g → W.Admits (l' t) t g

name.en: a formation withholding at a step, with memory

statement.en: under the law with memory (waitsAll), the formation a does not give at step n of the course from s: ¬ (Law.run (waitsAll up) s).state n a

name.en: a later step

statement.en: the step m is not before n: n ≤ m

name.en: a formation withholding at the start

statement.en: the formation b does not give at the start: ¬ s b

name.en: a chain of waits

statement.en: a chain of exactly k waits leads from b to a, each link taken into the formation that waits (Withholding.Chain up k b a); in withholding_returns a loop, from b back to b

name.en: the chain no longer than the step

statement.en: the chain's length is at most the step: k ≤ n

name.en: every formation within d waits

statement.en: every formation lies within d waits of b: Withholding.Within up d b a for every a

name.en: a step from d on

statement.en: the step n is at or after d: d ≤ n

name.en: total withholding at a step, with memory

statement.en: under the law with memory, every formation withholds at the step named of the course: ∀ a, ¬ (Law.run (waitsAll up) s).state n a

name.en: no chain of L waits

statement.en: no chain of exactly L waits exists: ¬ Withholding.Chain up L b a for every b and a

name.en: a step from L on

statement.en: the step n is at or after L: L ≤ n

name.en: more waiting

statement.en: the second relation of waiting holds every wait of the first: up b a → up' b a

name.en: giving under the added waits, with memory

statement.en: under the law with memory and the added waits, the formation a gives at step n: (Law.run (waitsAll up') s).state n a

name.en: giving under the added waits, without memory

statement.en: under the law without memory and the added waits, the formation a gives at step n: (Law.run (answers up') s).state n a

name.en: a law keeping inclusion

statement.en: the law of change keeps inclusion: from a configuration within another, it gives at the next step at least where it gives from the first (Tolerance.KeepsInclusion next)

name.en: a start within another

statement.en: whatever gives at the start s gives at the start s': s a → s' a

name.en: giving at a step from s

statement.en: the formation a gives at step n of the course from s under the law named (any law next; the tolerating law, a window): (Law.run next s).state n a

name.en: giving at a step from total withholding

statement.en: the formation a gives at step n of the course from total withholding under the law named (any law next; the tolerating law): (Law.run next allWithheld).state n a

name.en: restored at a step

statement.en: the formation a gives at step n of the course from every start, under the law named (any law next, or answers without memory): (Law.run next s).state n a for every s

name.en: a later step

statement.en: the step m is not before n: n ≤ m

name.en: none gives after total withholding

statement.en: no formation gives at the step after total withholding: ¬ next allWithheld a for every a

name.en: a clear chain of waits

statement.en: a chain of exactly k waits from b to a none of whose formations after the first is a source (Tolerance.Clear src up k b a); in clear_loop_withholds a loop from b back to b

name.en: no clear chain of L waits

statement.en: no clear chain of exactly L waits exists: ¬ Tolerance.Clear src up L b a for every b and a

name.en: a step from L on

statement.en: the step n is at or after L: L ≤ n

name.en: a step from 3 on

statement.en: the step n is at or after 3: 3 ≤ n

name.en: a formation sparing all it waits on

statement.en: the formation a waits on no more formations than its tolerance: (ups a).length ≤ tol a

name.en: no formation spares all it waits on

statement.en: every formation waits on more formations than its tolerance: ¬ (ups a).length ≤ tol a for every a

name.en: total withholding at a step under the tolerating law

statement.en: under the tolerating law, no formation gives at step m of the course from s: ¬ (Law.run (tolerating tol ups) s).state m a for every a

name.en: a set giving at the start

statement.en: every member of the set G gives at the start: G a → s a

name.en: each member waits on at most its tolerance outside the set

statement.en: each member of G waits on at most its tolerance of formations outside G: G a → AllBut G (tol a) (ups a)

name.en: a member of the set

statement.en: the formation a is in the set G: G a

name.en: the start gives outside the withholding set

statement.en: every formation outside W gives at the start: ¬ W a → s a

name.en: a thin withholding

statement.en: every formation waits on at most its tolerance of formations inside W: AllBut (fun b => ¬ W b) (tol a) (ups a) for every a

name.en: a set of domains giving at the start

statement.en: every domain of the set G gives at the start: G a → s a = true

name.en: a separated envelope

statement.en: every two admitted fault sets leave a domain of the roster outside both (FaultEnvelopes.separated roster faults); where the law names a set, for each of its domains

name.en: an admitted fault set covering the roster outside the set

statement.en: each domain of G has an admitted fault set holding every domain of its roster outside G: G a → ∃ bad ∈ faults a, ∀ d ∈ roster a, d ∈ bad ∨ G d

name.en: each formation requires its own condition alone

statement.en: each formation requires its own condition and only it, at every step: W.requires t a c ↔ c = a

name.en: a need k on its own condition

statement.en: each formation's need on its own condition is k a at every step: W.need t a a = k a

name.en: the level counts the supported upstream

statement.en: the level of a's condition at the next step is the number of formations a waits on that are supported now: W.level (t + 1) a = countTrue (fun b => k b ≤ W.level t b) (ups a)

name.en: a need no more than the number upstream

statement.en: each formation's need is at most the number it waits on: k a ≤ (ups a).length

name.en: one law keeping inclusion into another

statement.en: from configurations within others, the first law gives at the next step only where the second does (Tolerance.KeepsInclusionInto next next')

name.en: tolerances no smaller

statement.en: each formation's second tolerance is at least its first: tol a ≤ tol' a

name.en: a law keeping mutual giving

statement.en: the one-step law of a pair gives where both gave: f true true = true

name.en: a pair law keeping inclusion

statement.en: the two-input law on decided giving keeps inclusion: more giving in either input never gives less (WindowedWaiting.PairKeepsInclusion f)

name.en: a wider window

statement.en: the second window is at least the first: w ≤ w'

name.en: every formation waits on some formation

statement.en: every formation waits on some formation: ∀ a, ∃ b, up b a

name.en: errors spaced

statement.en: no formation errs at w consecutive steps (WindowedWaiting.Spaced e w)

name.en: a formation waiting on another

statement.en: the formation a waits on b: up b a

name.en: w + 1 consecutive errors

statement.en: the formation b errs at each of the w + 1 consecutive steps from t: e (t + i) b for i < w + 1

name.en: a constant withholder

statement.en: under a window of w + 1, the formation c withholds at lag 0 at every step from T of the run: ¬ (Law.run (answersWithin (w + 1) up) h).state t (c, 0) for T ≤ t

name.en: a step past the window

statement.en: the step n is at or after T + (w + 1)

name.en: a window of at least two

statement.en: the window is at least two: 2 ≤ w

name.en: a law keeping mutual withholding

statement.en: after two steps at which both formations withheld, the law withholds: f (false, false) (false, false) = false (PairChance.KeepsWithheld f); for each of the pair's two laws

name.en: a formation erring at a step

statement.en: the formation a errs at the step named: e s a = true

name.en: a formation withholding at its last two steps

statement.en: in the state x, the formation named withheld at both of its last two steps: x.2.1 = (false, false) for the first, x.2.2 = (false, false) for the second

name.en: a step from the burst on

statement.en: the step m is at or after the first step of the burst: t + 1 ≤ m

name.en: β at most γ

statement.en: the factor on steps received is at most the factor on steps withheld: β ≤ γ

name.en: a cohort listed in pairs

statement.en: every group of the cohort is a place and the other place of its pair: g ∈ gs → ∃ s, g = [s, s.other]

name.en: places not of the kind withhold

statement.en: every place of the cohort not of the kind holds withholding on its side: s.kind = false → s.law s.side = withholding

name.en: the kind answers

statement.en: every place of the kind holds answering on its side: s.kind = true → s.law s.side = answering

name.en: the kind never errs

statement.en: no place of the kind errs at any step on its side: s.kind = true → s.errs t s.side = false

name.en: at least one step

statement.en: the run counts at least one step: 0 < n

name.en: at least one step after the error

statement.en: the run counts at least one step after the error: 0 < m

name.en: laws giving after mutual giving

statement.en: every place's law gives after mutual giving, on each side: s.law first (true, true) (true, true) = true and s.law second (true, true) (true, true) = true

name.en: no errors

statement.en: no place errs: s.errs = noErrors

name.en: a common start

statement.en: the two flows start at the same level on every condition: W₁.level 0 c = W₂.level 0 c

name.en: takes and gives differing only by amounts that cancel

statement.en: at each step before T at which the two flows' levels agree, on each condition what one takes beyond the other it is given beyond it: L₁.taken t c + L₂.given t c = L₂.taken t c + L₁.given t c

name.en: a step up to T

statement.en: the step t is at most T: t ≤ T

name.en: the same levels up to n

statement.en: the two courses keep the same levels at every step up to n: W₁.level t c = W₂.level t c for t ≤ n and every c

name.en: a reading through the levels up to n

statement.en: the reading of offspring gives the same for level histories alike at every step up to n: (∀ t ≤ n, ∀ c, l t c = l' t c) → read l = read l'

name.en: at least one step

statement.en: n is positive: 0 < n

name.en: the giving course read as a + β n

statement.en: the reading of the giving course's levels is a + β n: read W₁.level = a + β * n

name.en: the withholding course read as a + γ n

statement.en: the reading of the withholding course's levels is a + γ n: read W₂.level = a + γ * n

name.en: the routes balance

statement.en: what is kept with what spoils is what reaches with what spills: P.kept + P.spoiled = P.reach + P.spill

name.en: no spill

statement.en: nothing of a gift spills on its route: P.spill = 0

name.en: no spoil

statement.en: nothing kept spoils: P.spoiled = 0

name.en: no matching

statement.en: the matching brings nothing: P.matched = 0

name.en: both intend to give in the first run

statement.en: in the first run both formations intend to give at every step: S₁.intends p t = true

name.en: neither intends to give in the second run

statement.en: in the second run neither formation intends to give at any step: S₂.intends p t = false

name.en: the same renewal offered

statement.en: the two runs offer the same renewal to each formation at each step: S₁.renew p t = S₂.renew p t

name.en: the same draws

statement.en: the two runs draw the same from each formation at each step: S₁.draw p t = S₂.draw p t

name.en: the same standings at the start

statement.en: the two runs start from the same standings: S₁.start = S₂.start

name.en: both formations active before the step

statement.en: in the first run both formations are active at every step before the bound: isActive G (levels G S₁ t) p = true for t < T and both p

name.en: a formation inactive at a step

statement.en: the formation p is not active at step t: isActive G (levels G S t) p = false

name.en: its partner giving it nothing from t on

statement.en: from t on, the partner sends p nothing: sends G S s (levels G S s) (partner p) = false for t ≤ s

name.en: active at the same steps before n

statement.en: the formation p is active at the same steps before n in the two runs: isActive G (levels G S₁ t) p = isActive G (levels G S₂ t) p for t < n

name.en: no dependence beyond breaks

statement.en: none of the dependences named on the conditions beyond breaks across the step: c ∈ rest → ¬ W.Broken t (dep c) c

name.en: the family rises by the factor

statement.en: the family's stock rises across the step by exactly the factor read: W.stock ds (t + 1) = W.stock ds t + β (γ at a withheld step)

name.en: no slack beyond and no inflow

statement.en: at every step below n at which the place receives, the slack beyond and the whole's inflow are nothing: W.slack dep rest t + L.inflow (ds ++ rest) t = 0

name.en: the place received at least once

statement.en: the place received at some step of the n: 0 < s.received n

name.en: an ignition move

statement.en: the move from x to y is an ignition: x holds the reserve and y has both sides active with the reserve used up (SeededContinuation.ignite x y)
